name: 06_locomo_large
description: Test case generated from LoCoMo. Tests memory of email agent with 10 probes across 1 sessions. The 50 queries were preprocessed and stored in initial memory.

steps.user_message: Can you remind me about what I have scheduled for March 20th at 11 AM?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: User has an upcoming medical appointment with Dr. James Wilson on March 20th at 11 AM.

success_check.query: The agent's response must contain the following information that should be recalled from memory: You have an upcoming medical appointment with Dr. James Wilson.
